# S66 — Mouse support: click tabs, rows and keys (needs ui.mouse)

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**2026-10-20** — Proposed, awaiting owner (2026-10-20 review), ui.mouse: off in v1; if built, opt-in by flag, because mouse capture stops terminal text selection (copying the slicer land command).

trust: unverified; by: Jon R

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Owners who use the pointer want to click tabs, rows and project keys. docs/dashboard.md:12 says mouse clicks do the same as keys. Decided: record 129 (ui.mouse): off in v1; if built, opt-in by flag. Mouse capture also blocks terminal text selection, which matters for copying the slicer land command (docs/dashboard.md:102-103).

## Failing tests

- TestClickOverviewRowMovesCursor: a click on a row matches down-arrow movement to that row.

- TestMouseOptInHandlesClicks: with the flag the clicks above work.
